does_not_do: No scheduler or orchestrator: runs are CLI invocations. The 'schedule' field in config/sources.yaml is declared at src/gridflow/config/settings.py:60 and read nowhere else in src/.
No cloud, object store, warehouse, streaming, multi-tenancy or cluster (vault 10-projects/gridflow/architecture.md 'Out of scope' + 'Storage stack').
No web service or public API; no hosted database. Local files plus an embedded DuckDB file.
No live or real-time feed claims: data lands when someone runs ingest.
Does not build connectors for the NESO Data Portal's other catalogue packages (only 3 of the portal's packages are implemented).
No ENTSO-E GB day-ahead prices (none in local silver; the GB benchmark comes from Elexon MID).
No modelling, forecasts or trading: models live in the separate gridflow_models repo; gridflow_models 'does not produce orders' (vault gridflow-models README).
No backfill for the NESO Data Portal datasets (current file only, refused by design).

metric_definitions.pinball_q0.5: mean quantile (pinball) loss at q=0.5 over scored rows; equals half the mean absolute error of the median forecast; unit = target unit (MW for demand). gridflow_models/validation/metrics.py:15
metric_definitions.coverage_90: share of actuals inside [q_0.05, q_0.95], bounds inclusive. validation/metrics.py:24, validation/record.py:70-80
metric_definitions.crps: approximated as the mean pinball loss over the 7 quantiles. validation/metrics.py:32
metric_definitions.gates: pinball_q0.5 <= 1500; coverage_nominal90 within 0.90 +/- 0.05; monotonicity = 0 crossing rows (card v2 gate lines; validation/gates.py)
metric_definitions.smp_bias: mean(clearing_price - APXMIDP) over scored periods, GBP/MWh (reproduced: -151.8012 over 816 periods; MAE 151.8012; median difference -95.34; every period under-predicts)
